purpose: Machine-readable contribution, authority and ownership areas for scalable OFU development.

routingPolicy.reason: A changed path with no declared area has no trustworthy review/ownership route and must be classified before merge.

areas.description: Universe identity, canonical addresses, deterministic kernel, foundational semantics and durable architecture decisions.
Scheduling, workers, streaming, materialization, caches and resource admission.
Deterministic composition, manifests, one-file build, package metadata and release reachability.
WebGL2/WebGPU, shaders, presentation packets, materials and GPU resources.
Cosmological, galactic, stellar and system astronomy models and presentation providers.
Planet interiors, worlds, atmospheres, climate, oceans and planetary diagnostics.
Terrain, geology, hydrology, local reference frames and surface materialization.
Life, ecology, evolution, organisms and biological embodiment.
Civilization, economy, institutions, settlements, infrastructure and history embodiment.
Persistent persons, demography, kinship, culture, knowledge and individual history.
Materials, tissue/cell continuity, microstructure, molecular and atomic depth.
Governed intervention, causal actions and cross-domain gameplay consequences.
Portable saves, replay, canonical history persistence, import/export and integrity.
Explore/Inspect/Lab product composition, direct manipulation and discovery.
Keyboard, focus, assistive semantics, reduced motion and inclusive interaction.
Systemic audio and audio accessibility behavior.
Scientific provenance, validation, model promotion and claim-integrity review.
Security boundaries, supply chain, untrusted input and privilege-sensitive workflows.
Open-source governance, licensing policy, contributor control plane, contributor experience, citation metadata and community operations.
